verdict.rationale: SigNoz lets you manage dashboards as code and read, download, or hand-edit a dashboard's full JSON spec, and service accounts give CI/CD pipelines programmatic access. Together these let a user version and review some configuration in external tooling such as git. There is no evidence of native version history, change review, or rollback for automations like alerts or log pipelines. Missing for 10: built-in versioning/history of alerts and pipelines, review/approval workflow, one-click rollback, and documentation or hands-on evidence of a config-as-code workflow beyond dashboards.
